exercises.name: push_up
coaching_cues: Place hands slightly wider than shoulder-width
Keep elbows at about 45 degrees from your body, not flared out
Keep a straight line from head to heels
Lower slowly and only as far as is pain-free
safety_warnings: Stop immediately if you feel pinching or sharp pain in the shoulder
Do not let your shoulders shrug up toward your ears
Drop to your knees if you cannot keep your body straight

warmup: Do 10 slow arm circles forward and backward, then 10 shoulder blade squeezes.
cooldown: Hold a gentle cross-body shoulder stretch for 30 seconds per arm, then a doorway chest stretch for 30 seconds.
overall_safety: This is a low-volume shoulder plan. Keep every rep slow and controlled. Stop and consult your physical therapist if shoulder pain increases during or after the session.
